title: Phone image viewer stays within the screen
caption: Long source checksums and filenames wrap within Review cards and image captions. Images and their controls stay inside the phone screen.

sections.title: Phone result
sections.caption: Public test card at its native 390 × 844 viewport. The full image, Close and both arrows remain visible.

images.caption: A long filename wraps below the complete image.

sections.title: Before and desktop check
sections.caption: These captures use public SVG test fixtures. No game artwork is involved.

images.caption: Before: an unbroken checksum expanded the layout to 492 pixels on a 390-pixel screen. The right edge and controls were offscreen.
Desktop at 1366 × 860: the portrait and controls fit.
